rules.expected: Structure identity, charge/spin and explicit frequency validation are present and internally consistent.

binding.comparison: expert semantic comparison The public experimental black trace is now available (vector Fig S1 extraction, not raw detector data or the fitted curve). Compare Z1-only relative spectra after the declared observed-origin/calculated-0-0 alignment. No absolute-origin accuracy, all-peak agreement, or fixed software mode number is required. Identify the physical in-plane-bending mode by displacement/FC evidence. Honest disagreement can earn evidence/process credit but is not automatically reproduction of the reference result; never fabricate experimental matches.

rules.expected: Actual calculated coverage, alignment, peak selection and at least two evidence-based hypotheses are documented. Use the public observed origin 19444 cm^-1 and the calculated 0-0 origin for relative comparison in 19400-20100 cm^-1. Preserve declared model/scaling/broadening choices; reference 0.9566 and 4 cm^-1 are not mandatory. Inspect matched and unmatched features, not only the most favorable peak.
